sources.title: Google Shell Style Guide
sources.note: Upstream targets Bash. Bash-only syntax must not be introduced into POSIX sh scripts.

documentation: Add a file-header purpose comment after the shebang.
Document library functions and non-obvious functions: purpose, Globals, Arguments, Outputs and Returns as applicable.
Describe exit-status meanings and destructive effects; explain surprising quoting or portability requirements.
rules: Declare the actual shell dialect; use local only when supported.
Quote expansions and forward arguments with "$@"; prefer $(...) over backticks.
Use Bash arrays or POSIX positional arguments for lists; avoid eval and command-string assembly.
Check important command/pipeline failures, write errors to stderr and use the correct ShellCheck dialect.
